segments.narration: Your phone battery drains daily. But what about your mental battery?
segments.screenAction: Split screen showing phone battery draining on left, person looking exhausted on right
segments.expectedResult: Viewer recognizes digital fatigue as a real energy drain
segments.visualPurpose: Establish parallel between physical and mental energy depletion

segments.narration: Like renewable energy powers our devices, we can renew our mental energy.
segments.screenAction: Animation showing renewable energy flowing into phone, then transforming into mental energy filling a person's silhouette
segments.expectedResult: Viewer understands the metaphor connecting renewable energy to mental health

segments.narration: Digital overloads create mental pollution, just like fossil fuels harm our environment.
segments.screenAction: Split screen showing social media notifications flooding one side, factory emissions on the other
segments.expectedResult: Viewer draws connection between digital overload and environmental pollution
segments.visualPurpose: Create an unexpected parallel between digital and environmental issues

segments.narration: Digital storage is like energy storage - both need efficient management.
segments.screenAction: Animation showing data storage filling up, then transitioning to battery storage visualization
segments.expectedResult: Viewer understands the relationship between digital storage and energy concepts
segments.visualPurpose: Explain the core metaphor through visual analogy

segments.narration: Practice digital mindfulness - your mind's renewable energy source.
segments.screenAction: Person meditating with phone in another room, peaceful energy radiating from them
segments.expectedResult: Viewer sees digital detox as a practical mental health strategy

segments.narration: When you manage your digital energy, you recharge your mental wellbeing.
segments.screenAction: Time-lapse of person going from frazzled to focused, with renewable energy symbols surrounding them
segments.expectedResult: Viewer understands the benefit of digital detox for mental health
segments.visualPurpose: Show the transformation and benefits clearly

segments.narration: Your mind is the most valuable renewable resource. Protect it.
segments.screenAction: Person looking peacefully at nature, with digital devices minimized in the background
segments.expectedResult: Viewer feels motivated to implement digital wellness practices
segments.visualPurpose: Leave viewer with a memorable call to action
